sql_log.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_rides, COUNT(DISTINCT ride_month) AS distinct_months, SUM(duration_min) AS total_duration_min FROM trips
SELECT rideable_type, COUNT(*) AS rides, SUM(duration_min) AS total_duration_min FROM trips GROUP BY rideable_type HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 ORDER BY rideable_type
SELECT ROUND(SUM(1.00 + CASE WHEN rideable_type = 'electric_bike' THEN 0.49 ELSE 0.19 END * duration_min), 2) AS total FROM trips
SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN rideable_type = 'electric_bike' THEN 0.17 * duration_min ELSE 0.17 * MAX(duration_min - 45, 0) END), 2) AS total FROM trips

SELECT ride_week, COUNT(*) AS rides, ROUND(AVG(duration_min), 2) AS avg_minutes, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN rideable_type = 'electric_bike' THEN 0.49 * duration_min ELSE 0.19 * duration_min END), 2) AS pay_per_use_spend FROM trips GROUP BY ride_week ORDER BY ride_week LIMIT 6
